raw_segments.text: Queen Margaret, bear with me, I am hungry for revenge, and now I cloy me with beholding
By Edward he is dead that killed my Edward, the other Edward dead to quit my Edward.
Young York he is but boot, because both they matched not the high perfection of my loss.
By Clarence he is dead that stabbed my Edward, and the beholders of this frantic play, T.H.,
adulterate hastings, rivers, vawn, gray, untimely smothered in their dusky graves.
Richard, yet lives, hell's black intelligencer, only reserve their factor to buy souls and
But at hand, at hand ensues his piteous and unpittied end.
Earth-gapes, hell-burns, fiends roar, saints pray, to have him suddenly conveyed from hence.
Cancel his bond of life, dear God, I pray, that I may live to say the dog is dead.
